title: Research: price the first profitable helper-star interface word (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Add `research/r439-helper-star-threshold-20261018/`, a scoped positive
H2-sem specialization with a complete local boundary and cost invoice.

- For three targets each requiring the helper response `a+h`, direct writes
  cost 6 scalar ADDs. Preparing `h ^= a`, writing each target from `h`, then
  restoring `h ^= a` costs 5 and has the same exact arbitrary-dirty boundary.
- In general for this fixed transformation, the direct cost is `2q` and the
  wrapped cost is `q+2`; `q=3` is the smallest strictly profitable case.
- The 3-by-2 semantic response matrix `N` equals the required `K`; all helpers
  restore, every gate is zero-frame, and no target feeds a helper.
- The local positive bill is `{ADD1: 6}` versus `{ADD1: 5}`, with `F=B=3` for
  both the direct and wrapped words. Two malformed controls fail.

## Verification

- `python3 -B research/r439-bsection-stars-seed01/verify.py` —
  `PASS_R439_BSECTION_STARS` at the pinned base.
- `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-helper-star-threshold-20261018`
  — registered replay passes all 64 binary dirty states in both directions,
  exact `N=K`, local F/B price and both controls.
- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-helper-star-threshold-20261018 --check-only`
  — `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`.

## Scope and overlap

Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`; package commit:
`af918214331e99a92758fe8069ce3b3e285c25fc`. This is an abstract six-register
microinstance, not a word in the selected R439 supplier. It proves no full
supplier admission, hosted invoice, selected moment, or new κ.

Open PR #3533 (head `c61d746404e534affd9fbcba1f2e448e45c06e42`) audits a
source-bound single restored edge against the literal K mask. Open PR #2721
(head `6b14e212a1aba401d29f2bf7378e745ee2aed7f2`) asks whether H2-sem's
no-target-feedback clause is needed at a framed level. This contribution uses
neither source-bound object and retains the no-target-feedback condition. The
broad H2-sem contract is credited to woklerx's PR1194; source-bound wraps and
their limits are credited in the README.

No PR was opened or posted from this worker. This file is prepared for later
review and submission.

## Publication validation

`python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-helper-star-threshold-20261018` passed on CPython 3.12.3, and `python3.12 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/r439-helper-star-threshold-20261018 --check-source-history` passed. The registered replay left the worktree clean. This supersedes any earlier pending note above for the registered package replay; separate full selected cold-replay limits remain as stated.

## CI update

This PR includes two shared CI repairs. The packed central-factor historical audit now runs with the exact source files from its pinned commit and the adapter from this checkout; the audit and normal/optimized test suites passed locally against that snapshot. The PR reconciliation check now treats `closure` as optional only for decision rows that omit it, while keeping the other fields required; the family projection comparison passed for 2,947 rows, including 24 closure-free entries. GitHub CI is rerunning for this head.


### CI update: historical documentation source inventory

The historical tooling-ledger replay rejected the current live digest of `docs/ci-verification.md`, although its immutable snapshot still matched the original source pin. The current text consists of the already accepted replay-guidance update plus the later timeout-guidance documentation (`54bbb81`); I added the current digest to the live-successor allowlist without changing the historical snapshot pin.

Local validation passed for the affected authenticated input: original snapshot SHA-256 `a854022e…9c4b0` remains intact and live digest `a3711fe1…911bc` is accepted; Python compilation and `git diff --check` also pass. Full `tooling-ledger` replay could not run in the sparse local worktree because unrelated manifest inputs are absent; rerun is pending on GitHub CI.
